brief:
The Guardian's archives feature a 2023 long read examining how Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister, has steered the country toward the political right since first taking office in 1996. The piece traces his influence across multiple terms and his sustained push to move Israeli policy in a more conservative direction.

The podcast draws from the Guardian's archive to revisit how Netanyahu's leadership reshaped domestic and political institutions over the span of his career in high office.
dek: We are raiding the Guardian long read archives to bring you some classic pieces from years past, with new introductions from the authors This week, from 2023: he first became prime minister in 1996 and has been pushing the country further right ever since.
title: Netanyahu shaped Israel rightward through three decades in power
